Admin Executive Job at Worknigeria




        
    

        
        Worknigeria was established with a Singular Vision. To help the vast Nigerian workforce find meaningful jobs. We are also on a mission to upskill them in the best ways possible and help them grow with and within their careers.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

 Job Position: Admin Executive

Job Location: Asaba, Delta
Employment Type: Full-time
Reports To: Plant Head / Admin Manager

Job Summary
     

            
    




	The role ensures the smooth operation of administrative functions, facility and work tools management, procurement, company registrations, and management of general office operations within the organization.
	The role also includes providing support for human resource management functions such as recruitment assistance, employee documentation, and compliance with HR policies and procedures.
	?Admin Executives or managers who reside in other locations and are willing to relocate are advised to apply


Key Responsibilities
Administrative Duties:


	Oversee daily administrative operations to ensure efficiency in office activities.
	Coordinate the front Office and see to the enquiries of visitors to the office as the need arises.
	Manage platform subscriptions and social media handles of the company.
	Maintain an organized filing system of company records, contracts, payments, registrations, and correspondence.
	Handle procurement of office supplies, equipment, and services, ensuring cost-effectiveness.
	Manage company assets, including inventory, repairs, and maintenance.
	Coordinate travel and accommodation arrangements for staff and company guests.
	Ensure compliance with corporate policies and regulatory requirements, particularly statutory renewals.
	Serve as a liaison between the company and vendors, service providers, and regulatory bodies.
	Oversee facility management, including office maintenance, security, cleanliness, and health & safety compliance.


Essential Function:


	General Office Administration
	Equipment Maintenance
	Inventory Management
	Fleet and Logistics Management
	Environment Management


Requirements


	Interested candidates should possess relevant qualifications
	Minimum of 5 years of experience as an Admin Manager or Executive in a manufacturing firm or Big Enterprise


Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities:


	Ability to communicate fluently
	Good Interpersonal skills
	Goal-oriented mentality
	Computer skills, e.g., MS Office
	Ability to present data coherently for decision-making
	Commitment to teamwork
	Ability to learn and apply best practices
	Ability to organize and plan tasks
	Flexibility and responsiveness to business needs
	Ability to overcome obstacles and organizational skill necessary to complete assignments in a
	Timely manner.
	Problem solving


Behavioural competencies:


	Proactiveness and ability to work with minimal supervision.
	Ability to take charge of a situation.
	Polite and respectful demeanor.
	Calm and confident disposition.


Salary
N600,000 - N700,000 monthly, and other benefits.

Method of Application

Interested and qualified candidates should send their CV to: [email protected] using the  Job Position as the subject of the email.

We have been manufacturing &nbsp;pharmaceutical and health products for over 40 years. We are promoting unlimited wellness by offering innovative, long-lasting medical solutions.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

Job Position: Supply and Demand Planning Manager
Job Location: Lagos Mainland, Lagos
Employment Type: Full-time

Role Summary

  "@context": "https://schema.org",
  "@type": "JobPosting",
  "title": "Trade Operations Officer",
  "description": "Standard Chartered Bank - We&#39;re an international bank, nimble enough to act, big enough for impact. For more than 160 years, we&#39;ve worked to make a positive difference for our clients, communities, and each other. We question the status quo, love a challenge and enjoy finding new opportunities to grow and do better than before. As a leading international bank, we strive to help people and businesses prosper across Asia, Africa and the Middle East.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

&nbsp;Job Position: Trade Operations Officer

Requisition Number: 63147
Job Location: Lagos
Job type: Full-time
Global Grade: Band 9
Work Type: Office Working
Employment Type: Permanent

Job Summary


	Provide accurate and timely pre-processing, scanning, registration, custody and handover of documentary trade and client instructions.
	Support delivery of agreed turnaround times, robust operational controls and complete transaction records across Core Trade Operations.
	Contribute to safe, compliant and client-focused trade processing in line with Group policies, local regulations and conduct standards.
	Deliver excellent client service to the bank&rsquo;s client.


Key Responsibilities
Trade Document Intake and Pre-processing:


	Receive and time-stamp Final Exchange Control Documents, input reference details, register instructions and scan them to the processing team
	Scan all registered documents to the processing team, generate the Automated shipping document (ASD) report and upload shipping documents to ASD.


Processing Control, Custody and Reporting:


	Prepare PPS and document checks for Letters of Credit (LC) and Bills for collection (BFC) originals, monitor workflow movement to the maker queue and hand over documents to processors against signed registers.
